html:
Greetings, Agents. 
 
This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

The heroes that will join the first update of 2023 
are the Moon Temple Defenders and the next-generation Spider-Man!
Check out their powerful gear and new abilities.

 

Shadow Shell, one of the Moon Temple Defenders,
will be available for Tier-4 Advancement.
Shadow Shell and War Tiger, as united Warriors of the Sky, 
will show stronger powers with their new Uniforms and Artifacts.

 

Tier-3 Advancement, a Uniform inspired by the 10th Anniversary of the comics, 
and an Artifact will be given to Spider-Man (Miles Morales), 
who will now have more responsibilities as Spider-Man.

 

Agents, challenge Dispatch Mission Sector 13 with the updated heroes!

 

Various improvements for mission contents and the Craft system 
will be made to help Agents prepare for future battles. 
Please check the details below.

 


▣ Three New Uniforms
 
The young man who will live up to the legacy of Spider-Man
and two new defenders have arrived in MARVEL Future Fight.
Check out the abilities of Shadow Shell <Moon Temple Defenders>, 
War Tiger <Moon Temple Defenders>, and Spider-Man (Miles Morales) <Anniversary Special>.
* New Uniform Skills are based on the following skill Level stats. (Tier-4 heroes: Lv. 10, Others: Lv. 6)
* The three new Uniforms will be discounted by 40% during the <January Update Celebration Event>, 
and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and the Uniform Room after the event.

 

 

 

 


▣ Spider-Man (Miles Morales) Tier-3

 

Spider-Man (Miles Morales) has gained new powers through Tier-3 Advancement.
His bio-electricity and web control abilities will help dominate his enemies!

 

 

 


▣ Shadow Shell Tier-4

 

Shadow Shell has gained new powers through Tier-4 Advancement.
Shadow Shell will help stabilize your battles with her great strategies and poison.
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 


▣ Dispatch Mission Sector 13 Release
 
Participate in Dispatch Mission and confront the crises that have occurred in each Sector!
Sector 13, Asgard, need the help of our Agents.
 
1. Sector 13, Asgard, has been added.
There are a total of five stages in Sector 13.
- Clear the challenges to acquire bonuses that will help you receive more supplies.

 


2. Energy, Titan Component Pack, Essence of Dimension, and Dispatch Tokens 
can be acquired as a reward in Sector 13.

 

 
3. Dispatched heroes can now be removed at once.
 

 


4. The Sector to be selected when using the <Next Reward> feature has been changed.
- Before: Rises from Sector 1 regardless of the current Sector
- After: Rises from the current Sector and then rises again 

from the lowest Sector when there are remaining Sectors.
 
 
▣ Mission Content Improvements
 
Various features have been improved to help battles in mission content.
 
1. Agents can now use the <Auto Progress> button when dialogues are displayed 
in specific mission contents to auto-progress the dialogues.
 

 
2. The Auto Play+ feature can now be used 
without 3★ Clear / VIP requirements in specific mission contents.
 
3. The UI for the view feature has been simplified 
except for features that can be used when Auto-Playing specific content.
 
4. The HP of self-explosive robots that appear in Normal Story stages 2-1 to 2-3 has been lowered.
 
 
▣ New Artifacts

 

Exclusive Passive Skill Artifacts for Shadow Shell, War Tiger, 
and Spider-Man (Miles Morales) will be added after the January Update. 
* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 


▣ New Future Pass Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass will begin after the update.
Obtain various rewards and Special Icons with the Future Pass.

 

[Future Pass Rewards]

- Please note that the Future Pass effects 
will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Legendary / Mythic Future Pass that has been unlocked 

will only be applied during the season the Pass was purchased, 

and the Pass rewards will only be available during the same season. 
Please don’t forget to check the remaining event time.
- The Mythic Pass can be purchased after purchasing the Legendary Pass.
- Legendary and Mythic Future Passes will not be available for purchase 
when the season is about to end. Please check the sale schedule in the game.

 

​New Special Icons that will represent you have been added.
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Rewards and two more from the upcoming Events!

 

[January Update New Special Icons]
   

 


▣ One New Uniform Collection

 

Check out the amazing Uniforms of the Moon Temple Defenders.
Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn a reward.

 

 


▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. Agents can now use the skip button to check the results right away by 10 times when crafting.
- The Stop / Relay Craft feature that could be used during or after Craft has been removed.

[1/10 (Tue) 9:20 (UTC+0), 1/10 (Tue) 1:20 (PST) added] 

The text has been partially changed.

 

 

2. The Craft count increase and decrease button feature has been improved.

 

3. The acquisition point and requirements of the <5 Day S.H.I.E.L.D.'S Special Support> 
for new Agents has been changed so that Agents can use all the benefits.
- Before: Clear Story Stage 1-1
- After:
Clear Story Stage 8-3
Daily Benefits: When S.H.I.E.L.D. Special Support benefits are not applied
When the Inventory is full 

 

4. Products that are displayed in certain conditions and pop-up products have been added & improved.

 

5. Some text of skill effects that decreases specific abilities have been adjusted. 

 

6. A notice badge will now be displayed on the Purchase All button
when there are items that can be purchased with the Purchase All feature.

 

7. The number of certain items that have been acquired 
can now be checked on the result pop-up screen after using the Purchase All feature.

 

8. The last status of the checkboxes for each product at the Purchase All screen will now be saved.

 

9. When proceeding with the initial tutorial, 
Agents can now use the skip button after all the data has been downloaded.

 

10. Keywords for Tier-4 materials have been added to the search feature at the Store.

 


▣ Game Error Fixes

 

1. The issue of the new Uniform label being displayed for the Cyclops <Classic> Uniform 
at the hero change pop-up of the skill preview has been fixed. 
 
2. The issue of the design effect of the sword of Magik <Modern> 
not being applied in certain angles has been fixed.​
 
3. The issue of recent Alliance chatting messages not being displayed in certain cases has been fixed.
 
4. The issue of the effect of some patterns not being shown in 
World Boss: Legend <Infinity Ultron> when the graphics option is set to very low has been fixed.
 
5. The issue of the “removes Active Buff from Target” effect 
of the 2nd active skill of Namor <Marvel Studios’ Black Panther: Wakanda Forever> 
being applied to Boss-type enemies as well has been fixed.
 
6. The issue of the unlock requirement of the 
Select Mission - Arena tab being wrongly displayed has been fixed.
 
7. The issue of the Leader Skill name not being displayed when using the Leader Skill 
of Gorr <Marvel Studios’ Thor: Love and Thunder> has been fixed.
 
8. The skill description of Storm’s Tier-4 Striker skill 
on the elemental damage accumulation effect has been fixed to be shown by percentage.
 
We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.
 
Thank you.
